accepted_increments.summary: Initialized repo-local Codex harness state, environment actions, reusable workflow skill copies, Python 3.11 venv setup, and tinygrad 0.12 device-context compatibility for tinygrad-gemma.
Made decode fallback explicit when tinygrad rejects symbolic Metal cache-store JIT graphs, extended the Metal smoke gate through generation, and recorded fallback status in benchmark rows.
Restored legal Metal TinyJit replay by replacing raw symbolic UOp cache stores with tinygrad's public slice assign/realize cache-write idiom, then pinned no-fallback decode in the Metal smoke gate.

Avoided physical K/V head repetition in the measured text decode path by reshaping grouped-query attention, improving the E2B int8 METAL 200-token warmup-excluded row from 8.918411 tok/s to 10.659780 tok/s.
Refreshed the real E2B int8 METAL 1000-token beam=0 floor on the grouped-query path, producing a no-fallback row with rollout_jit_count=999 and 6.245549 warmup-excluded tok/s.

Ported the Metal-only sliding-window decode JIT switch into the conditional generation path used by E2B int8, improving the 1000-token warmup-excluded row from 6.245549 tok/s to 8.300076 tok/s with decode_fallback=false.

Profiled the post-window decode TinyJit, then fused inference-only MLP gate/up projections, improving the E2B int8 METAL 1000-token warmup-excluded row from 8.300076 tok/s to 9.303522 tok/s with decode_fallback=false.

Made the E2B int8 checkpoint genuinely rowwise-int8, installed runtime int8 Linear modules on METAL, and improved the 1000-token warmup-excluded row from 9.303522 tok/s to 10.721864 tok/s with decode_fallback=false.
Refreshed the post-int8 decode TinyJit profile and rejected moving conditional token embedding out of the JIT after the real 200-token row regressed from 15.751897 tok/s to 11.272605 tok/s.
Fused rowwise-int8 MLP gate/up projections inside replay, improving the E2B int8 METAL 1000-token warmup-excluded row from 10.721864 tok/s to 10.863932 tok/s with decode_fallback=false.

Added a METAL lowering diagnostic for the Gemma 4 E2B decode-shape rowwise-int8 gate/up linear and recorded that the exact one-token path does not use simdgroup MMA while tinygrad's visible Metal tensor-core registry has no int8 input dtype.

Added a raw tinygrad MetalProgram prototype for the E2B rowwise-int8 gate/up decode linear; the threadgroup-x variant is correct against NumPy and measured 0.123437 ms median over 100 replays, faster than the prior 0.185354 ms tinygrad lowering diagnostic but not yet integrated into Gemma decode.

Extracted the raw Metal threadgroup-x rowwise-int8 decode linear into tinygrad_gemma.metal_int8, added a tensor-wrapper module check to the prototype artifact, and pinned the non-METAL boundary in tests. The refreshed prototype measured 0.123437 ms median and module_check.passed=true, but no Gemma throughput row was superseded.

Added a METAL diagnostic proving the raw rowwise-int8 runtime primitive is unsafe to wire directly into TinyJit decode: float32 produces no capture, while bfloat16 captures one cast kernel and replays the stale capture-time raw Metal output. No Gemma throughput row was superseded.

Made the raw Metal rowwise-int8 decode linear participate in TinyJit replay by appending a repo-local custom Runner ExecItem during capture. The bridge diagnostic now reports safe_for_decode_tinyjit_replay for float32 and bfloat16 inputs under JIT=1 and JIT=2, but no Gemma throughput row was superseded.

Wired the replay-safe raw Metal rowwise-int8 gate/up primitive into GemmaMLP behind strict METAL/decode guards, then rejected it as a default path after the real E2B int8 METAL 200/20 row regressed to 6.609982 tok/s despite decode_fallback=false and rollout_jit_count=199. The raw path is now explicit opt-in only.

Extended the decode TinyJit profiler to compare default and opt-in raw gate/up under JIT=1 Metal graph batching, proving the raw custom Runner fragments the post-window decode graph from 8 MetalGraph batches to 37 MetalGraph batches plus 35 raw runner launches and grows the profiled token from 67.716500 ms to 197.940124 ms. No throughput row was superseded.

Pinned the benchmark matrix default to include the beam=0 acceptance row and added tests that keep benchmark_checkpoint on the current load_pretrained contract, preventing stale int8-loader kwargs from turning measurement runs into load_error rows. No throughput row was superseded.

Explicitly abandoned the raw Metal rowwise-int8 gate/up Runner as a Gemma decode optimization route after graph-fragmentation evidence and a fresh raw-mode profiler failure. Production GemmaMLP stays on the graphable tinygrad-native fused int8 path, and raw profiler/diagnostic entrypoints now report the abandonment instead of silently enabling the custom Runner. No throughput row was superseded.

Updated the decode TinyJit profiler for current tinygrad CapturedJit.linear graph calls and attributed the default JIT=1 MetalGraph profile back to source item ranges. The refreshed artifact proves 8 MetalGraph rows account for all 5239 source items with no unparsed batches, no count mismatches, and no unattributed tail. Current lowered graph metadata is unclassified, so no throughput row or source-category bottleneck was superseded.

Rejected the simple current JIT=2 sidecar category-recapture path. Real E2B int8 METAL JIT=2 sidecar profiling matches the graph source count at 5239 rows, including with TRACEMETA=2 set at process start, but every row remains category=other with unclassified source metadata. No throughput row or source-category bottleneck was superseded.

Added a minimal METAL diagnostic for tinygrad metadata preservation through TinyJit capture. Direct lazy Tensor ops preserve TRACEMETA caller metadata, but both JIT=1 and JIT=2 CapturedJit.linear calls and lowered ExecItems have zero metadata, proving category loss happens before captured-linear profiling rather than inside the Gemma profiler join. No throughput row was superseded.

Extended the tinygrad metadata diagnostic with a repo-local TinyJit.add_linear sidecar patch that tags captured LINEAR calls from Python scope. Native tinygrad metadata is still lost before CapturedJit.linear, but the sidecar preserves metadata through captured calls and lowered ExecItems under both JIT=1 and JIT=2. No throughput row was superseded.

Integrated the repo-local TinyJit.add_linear sidecar into the Gemma decode graph profiler. The refreshed default JIT=1 E2B int8 METAL artifact keeps complete 8-row MetalGraph attribution over all 5239 source items and now records non-other repo-sidecar realization-scope attribution: 4520 attention-scoped source items and 719 unclassified source items. This is profiler instrumentation only; no throughput row was superseded.

Refined the Gemma decode graph profiler's attention sidecar with a profiler-only Tensor.realize wrapper that tags attention-scoped STORE graphs as attention_cache_write. The refreshed default JIT=1 E2B int8 METAL artifact keeps complete 8-row MetalGraph attribution over all 5239 source items and shows all 4520 previously attention-scoped source items are cache-write realization scope, with 719 source items still unclassified in the final graph range. This is profiler instrumentation only; no throughput row was superseded.

Factored GemmaAttention cache updates into a behavior-preserving sequential helper and let the decode graph profiler monkeypatch that helper to split attention cache-store attribution into key-cache and value-cache writes. The refreshed default JIT=1 E2B int8 METAL artifact keeps complete 8-row MetalGraph attribution over all 5239 source items and shows an even split: 2260 key-cache-write source items, 2260 value-cache-write source items, and 719 unclassified source items. This is profiler instrumentation only; no throughput row was superseded.

Extended the cache-write profiler sidecar with GemmaAttention layer-role metadata to test shared-KV cache-write elision feasibility. The refreshed default JIT=1 E2B int8 METAL artifact shows zero shared-consumer cache writes; all classified cache writes are required local producers or shared-source producers. No throughput row was superseded.

Added structural summaries for unclassified decode graph source items. The refreshed default JIT=1 E2B int8 METAL artifact keeps complete 8-row MetalGraph attribution over all 5239 source items and shows the remaining 719 unclassified source items are all Ops.SINK roots in the final graph batch, headed by repeated r_16_96 and logits/norm-shaped display signatures. This is profiler instrumentation only; no throughput row was superseded.

Patched the decode TinyJit profiler with a profiler-only UOp creation sidecar and UOp.replace propagation so the previous 719-item final tail becomes source-attributed. The refreshed E2B int8 METAL artifact shows 96.28% of profiled decode-token time is attention cache-write work and only 3.72% is MLP, while a 128/16 beam=0 tok/s gate measured 17.504447 warmup-excluded tok/s with decode_fallback=false. This is instrumentation/benchmark improvement only; the accepted 1000/20 floor was not superseded.

Narrowed decode cache writes to single-position slice assignment, added rolled physical storage for sliding-window cache entries while preserving full-length shared-KV sources, and fixed profiler import compatibility with stock tinygrad. The real E2B int8 METAL 128/16 row improved to 19.199621 tok/s and the accepted 1000/20 floor improved from 10.863932 to 11.076822 tok/s with decode_fallback=false.

Added a graphable tinygrad-native fused rowwise-int8 K/V projection for non-shared attention producer layers. The accepted E2B int8 METAL 1000/20 floor improved from 11.076822 to 11.378305 tok/s with decode_fallback=false and stable output hash. A repeat 128/16 short gate measured 19.425499 tok/s; the first short run measured 19.087715, so short-gate noise remains visible. Post-window source-attributed profile improved from 70.717625 ms/token to 66.724416 ms/token with 8 MetalGraph batches and complete attribution, but source counts remain unchanged.

Allowed rolled physical storage for sliding shared-KV source layers while keeping full-attention shared sources absolute. The repeated E2B int8 METAL 1000/20 floor improved from 11.378305 to 11.740118 tok/s (best run 11.762429) with decode_fallback=false and stable output hash; full pytest now passes 63 tests.

Packed key/value cache storage into a single backing tensor and routed decode cache updates through one packed assignment, reducing the post-window captured source graph from 5239 to 2994 source items and improving the repeated E2B int8 METAL 1000/20 floor from 11.740118 to 18.537605 tok/s with decode_fallback=false and stable output hash.

Moved packed K/V backing storage from a leading lane to a final lane, preserving packed key/value views while slightly improving the clean E2B int8 METAL 1000/20 floor from 18.537605 to 19.053995 tok/s with decode_fallback=false and stable output hash. Source count remained 2994, so the next target remains direct packed cache-write graph reduction.

Rejected option 2 as a runtime implementation increment after source-level tinygrad research and profile evidence showed high-level assign/realize cannot exclude lazy K/V producer work from cache-write realization; pre-realizing RHS matches the already-rejected prepacked producer path. No throughput row was superseded; accepted runtime floor remains packed-kv-lastdim-cache-assignment-034 at 19.053995 tok/s.

Merged profiler-only packed-cache layer/type attribution and rejected parallel runtime probes by profile/long-floor evidence. Mainline runtime remains the packed-kv-lastdim cache layout; refreshed repeated E2B int8 METAL 1000/20 rows measured 19.424036 and 19.613212 tok/s with stable hash, rollout_jit_count=999, and decode_fallback=false. Parity, active-cache no-op guard, flat-slot layout, and deferred-readback candidates were not accepted.

Audited /Users/ericfode/src/gemma4-tinygrad-opt for transferable optimizations. Packed K/V cache, fused int8 gate/up, and fused int8 K/V are already present or stronger in this recipient; donor benchmark rows are full-forward CUDA/T4 hints, not comparable to real E2B int8 METAL autoregressive decode. A temporary donor-style SDPA attention branch produced the same short-output hash but slightly worse measured decode throughput (30.769433 vs 30.808261 tok/s) and a worse source-attributed profile (70.510040 vs 44.466920 ms/token), so it was removed and no runtime floor was superseded.

Parsed the latest source-attributed MetalGraph profile and confirmed the 7 graph rows are tinygrad JIT_BATCH_SIZE grouping artifacts rather than semantic fusion boundaries. Recorded synthetic JIT_BATCH_SIZE evidence, identified a source/artifact coherence blocker because live model.py is split-cache while accepted artifacts/tests expect packed-cache runtime APIs, and set the next measured probe to restore packed-cache coherence before running a JIT_BATCH_SIZE=0 profile/throughput gate. No runtime tok/s floor was superseded.

Restored live source/artifact coherence for the final-lane packed-cache runtime, removed the profiler split-cache fallback, and rejected JIT_BATCH_SIZE=0 as a default runtime knob. JIT_BATCH_SIZE=0 collapsed the source-coherent profile from 7 MetalGraph batches to 1 and improved the same-state profile from 37.935 to 36.396 ms/token, but the hard E2B int8 METAL 1000/20 row regressed from 18.954322 to 18.685010 tok/s with stable hash, rollout_jit_count=999, and decode_fallback=false. No accepted throughput floor was superseded.

Added profiler-only layer-13 phase/sub-attribution support and a stock-tinygrad compatibility guard for missing TinyJit.add_linear. The real METAL layer-13 phase profile still failed to preserve child phase categories (885 unclassified shared-source layer-13 items), while structural evidence identified reduce_r-heavy graph mass. A temporary greedy softcap-elision runtime probe was then rejected on the hard E2B int8 METAL metric: 128/16 measured 28.378910 tok/s and repeated 1000/20 rows measured 17.572001 and 17.121386 tok/s, below the current accepted floor; the runtime patch was reverted. No throughput floor was superseded.

Reduced profiler phase-attribution overhead by caching cache-write category parsing, avoiding recursive source-edge phase scans in hot UOp creation/replace and add_linear paths, then refreshed the real METAL layer-13 phase-propagation profile. The profile preserved complete attribution over 2994 source items and recovered child phase metadata for 872/885 layer-13 shared-source rows: kv_projection=863, store=9, with 13 unclassified and 37 conflicts. The resulting analysis maps the reduce_r-heavy layer-13 parent scope to K/V projection rather than RHS packing or the cache store tail; no runtime throughput floor was superseded.

Initialized and calibrated evo for model.py performance probes, then rejected K/V-projection/view and unit-scaling candidates that failed to beat the calibrated frontier. exp_0005 is the no-code current comparison point at 28.6153 tok/s on the default 128/20 score and passed the recalibrated 1000/20 hash floor at 18.090845 tok/s. exp_0006 passed behavior gates and the current long floor but regressed the calibrated default score to 28.4567, so it was discarded.

Rejected the two follow-up evo model.py probes after recalibrating exp_0005 as the current frontier. exp_0007 flattened one-token fused-int8 K/V decode matmul rank and passed focused tests plus current hash/long gates, but regressed the default 128/20 score to 28.4375 versus exp_0005 at 28.6153. exp_0008 elided one-token attention-output merge views and passed tests, profile-decode, smoke/help, and hash gates, but regressed the default score to 28.4258 and its long 1000/20 row measured 18.078904, below the exp_0005 long calibration at 18.090845. No runtime throughput floor was superseded; exp_0005 remains the frontier.

Rejected the RMSNorm immutable inference scale-cache probe. exp_0009 cached realized inference scale tensors for plus-one and ordinary RMSNorm weights and passed focused parity/safety tests, full behavior/profile tests, CLI help, Metal smoke, and the short hash gate, but regressed the default 128/20 score to 26.1647 versus exp_0005 at 28.6153 and failed the inherited E2B int8 METAL 1000/20 current-floor gate.

Rejected evo exp_0014. Lane-before-head-dim packed-cache backing layout passed focused cache/profile tests but regressed the active short score to 27.2326 versus exp_0005 at 28.6153 and preserved source_count=2994 / graph_batch_count=7 with a slower 53.861 ms post-window profile.

completed_increments.summary: Surveyed the dormant raw rowwise-int8 METAL decode-linear runner before making code changes. Focused RowwiseInt8/metal_int8 tests passed, and a stock-tinygrad prototype sweep for shape 1536->12288 measured local_size 64/128/256 at 0.300875/0.124333/0.104708 ms median with correctness passing. The actual research tinygrad path used by the E2B evo harness failed a direct raw-runner canary with RuntimeError: Invalid library file because metal_int8.py passes Metal source bytes to Device.runtime while the research MetalProgram expects compiled MTLB bytes. A real E2B int8 METAL hash16 gate on unchanged source passed with 30.327774 measured tok/s, stable hash, rollout_jit_count=15, and decode_fallback=false. No code change was adopted; do not integrate the raw runner into RowwiseInt8Linear or tune its default local_size under the active benchmark without a separate compatibility target.

Rejected evo exp_0010, a graphable model.py probe from frontier exp_0005 that stored active K/V tensors in shared_kv_states for full-length shared-KV producers instead of reusing the bounded cache entry. The focused red/safety test first caught repeated shared-consumer reslicing and the implementation passed that test plus tests/test_tinygrad_gemma.py and tests/test_profile_decode_jit.py, CLI help, Metal smoke, and short/long E2B int8 METAL hash gates. The default 128/20 score regressed to 28.2824 versus parent exp_0005 at 28.6153, so exp_0010 was discarded and exp_0005 remains the frontier.

Accepted a narrow compatibility patch for the dormant raw rowwise-int8 METAL decode-linear runner. _rowwise_int8_decode_linear_program now compiles ROWWISE_INT8_DECODE_LINEAR_SOURCE via Device[METAL].compiler.compile_cached and passes compiled MTLB bytes to Device.runtime, fixing the research tinygrad Invalid library file failure without integrating the raw runner into RowwiseInt8Linear or claiming throughput. A focused TDD test first failed because compile_cached was not called, then passed; the research tinygrad METAL canary printed ok metal_int8 research MTLB canary; full pytest, CLI help, Metal smoke, and git diff --check passed.

Accepted a narrow capture-safety patch for the dormant raw rowwise-int8 METAL decode-linear runner. Stock-style TinyJit capture objects with add(ExecItem) still record the raw runner and execute the capture pass; add_linear-only research tinygrad capture now raises a clear RuntimeError before kernel execution, avoiding a silent capture/replay bypass. A real stock TinyJit METAL canary replayed three different inputs correctly, while the research canary rejected capture explicitly. No model hot-path integration or throughput claim was made.

Accepted a prototype-only feasibility spike for representing the dormant raw rowwise-int8 METAL decode-linear runner in the research tinygrad add_linear capture world. The inspectable script first reproduces the production helper rejection, then installs a temporary process-local pm_exec/_call_outs_ins bridge for Ops.CUSTOM_FUNCTION(arg="raw_rowwise_int8_decode_linear"), preserves UOps until resolve_params(ctx, call) at replay time, verifies three distinct METAL replay inputs against NumPy, proves a later tinygrad op can consume the output, and restores globals. No production model path was changed and no throughput improvement is claimed.

Rejected production integration of the raw rowwise-int8 METAL custom Runner as a first-class graphable decode path. Research tinygrad GraphRunner.supports_exec_item admits only Ops.SINK/Ops.PROGRAM single-device calls, and MetalGraph construction assumes CompiledRunner-backed pipeline_state and launch_dims. The 051 pm_exec/_call_outs_ins bridge remains prototype-only because it requires process-local monkeypatching and is not a MetalGraph batching surface. Pruned the dead GemmaMLP raw-gate/up hook and removed the profile_decode_jit --metal-int8-gate-up selector while preserving the historical default metadata field. No throughput floor is superseded.

Allocated evo exp_0011 from exp_0005 and tested decode-only graphable rowwise-int8 Q/K/V projection fusion. Focused parity, core tests, METAL smoke, and hash16 passed, but evo run measured 27.7816 tok/s versus parent 28.6153 and failed the inherited long E2B floor.
